responsibility: Standardize automatic microanimations for generated Dysium cards and their sub-elements.

defaultPolicy.escalationRule: Use GSAP only for sequenced page or spatial choreography; ordinary card hover stays CSS-owned.

accessibility.reducedMotion: Disable transform travel and keep color, outline, and shadow state changes readable.
accessibility.keyboard: Focus-within receives the same state as hover.
accessibility.coarsePointer: Keep transition but avoid relying on hover to reveal required information.

performance.layoutRule: Never animate width, height, top, left, margin, padding, or grid placement for card hover.
performance.dependencyPolicy: No runtime dependency is installed for default microanimations.
